rules.description: Applicant must be receiving the Enhanced Rate of the Mobility Component of PIP
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be receiving the Enhanced Rate of the Mobility Component of Personal Independence Payment (PIP) to use the Motability scheme

rules.description: PIP award must have at least 12 months remaining
rules.reason_if_failed: Your PIP award must have at least 12 months remaining to start a Motability lease

rules.description: Applicant must be a UK resident
rules.reason_if_failed: The Motability scheme is only available to UK residents

rules.description: PIP mobility allowance must be in payment
rules.reason_if_failed: Your PIP mobility allowance must be in payment to use the Motability scheme

rules.description: Applicant must not have another active Motability agreement
rules.reason_if_failed: You already have an active Motability agreement. Contact Motability to discuss upgrading or changing your vehicle.

edge_cases.description: Applicant receives War Pensioners' Mobility Supplement
edge_cases.action: Eligible under alternative scheme. Route to War Pensioners' Motability pathway.

edge_cases.description: Applicant receives Armed Forces Independence Payment
edge_cases.action: Eligible under AFIP scheme. Route to Armed Forces Motability pathway.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has terminal illness with special rules
edge_cases.action: Fast-track application. Contact Motability specialist team for urgent processing.

edge_cases.description: Applicant requires vehicle adaptations for disability
edge_cases.action: Route to adaptations assessment. May be eligible for additional grant funding.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has PIP reassessment due within 12 months
edge_cases.action: Proceed with caution. Inform applicant that lease depends on continued Enhanced Rate award.
